title: mdaa_bench: simulation bench for blind identification of latent dynamical structure (MDAA)

creators.name: Bonomo, Hudson A. R.
creators.affiliation: TMU-LAB — The Machine Unconscious Lab, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

description:
This version adds the third bench to the repository: the record standing bench, supplementary material for Paper 5 (Memory in Situated Learning Accessibility, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22815088).

What is new. Four planted worlds test whether a record reader can distinguish the four standing states — applicable, out of scope, aged, unevaluable — when distinct mechanisms produce the same observable trajectory of signals. Three readers: R_declared calls the @tmulab/mdaa plugin by subprocess, R_decay is the recency comparator from the agent literature, R_current is the plugin before the standing layer.

Pre-registration and amendments. The pre-registration (standing/PREREGISTRO_v1.md) was frozen at commit 0851ac7, with SHA-256 hashes verified by a guardian test. Three amendments — v1.1 (R_decay kernel fixed), v1.2 (P1 moves to R_decay with a measure over weights), v1.3 (P3 clarified, P5 redefined as divergence) — were all committed before any grid seed was run.

Grid. 400 runs (20 cells × 20 seeds) with the three readers. The seven pre-registered predictions (P1, P1b, P2, P3, P4, P4b, P5) pass at the declared thresholds. Results in standing/resultados/grid_v1_predictions.md.

Measured CLI. R_declared calls dist/standing-cli.js from @tmulab/mdaa. The SHA-256 of the build measured in the grid is 8c3cf88999013bca8c55ae0905055f27327a931301e70d4ddd29388f26302543, generated by commit 4503cc1 of the tmulab-mdaa repository.

Parked red test. test_prereg.py::test_document_is_regenerated_from_the_code fails because PREREGISTRO_v3.md carries the hash of a commit earlier than HEAD. This test generates the document by introspection from the code and compares it with the committed file; the hash changes at every commit. It is pre-existing from before this version's series of cells, it does not affect the record standing bench (which has its own guardian in test_freeze_guardian.py), and it was not fixed because the fix is a cell of its own in the v3/v4 series, not a ride-along.
